title: Analyze Solomon Four-Group Designs (Classic & Modern)
text: Tools analyze Solomon Four-Group Designs (SFGD) classic teaching workflow modern unified GLM: - Classic flow: 2×2 posttest ANOVA → (sensitization) ANCOVA pretested cells + posttest-t, optional Stouffer combine (Braver & Braver, 1988). - Modern flow: one GLM robust SEs + key contrasts, permutation p-values, effect sizes, diagnostic helpers.

what: solomonR: Analyze Solomon Four-Group Designs — solomonR
title: solomonR: Analyze Solomon Four-Group Designs — solomonR
text: Implements (1) classic Solomon analysis path (2x2 posttest ANOVA check pretest sensitization, ANCOVA pretested cells posttest-t-test), plus optional Stouffer Z "Test " (Braver & Braver, 1988); (2) unified GLM estimates treatment, pretest indicator, interaction, using ANCOVA logic pretested cells robust permutation-based inference.

title: solomonR: Analyze Solomon Four-Group Designs — solomonR
text: Key references: Huck & Sandler (1973) classic workflow; Braver & Braver (1988) Stouffer Z; Sawilowsky & Markman critiques replies (1988–1990) cautions selection bias issues. Teaching overviews included.
